model_annotation: The chart illustrates the distribution of training set quantity, verification set quantity, and accuracy rate across five categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as 实体识别 (Entity Recognition), 角色识别 (Role Recognition), 异常识别 (Anomaly Recognition), 空间推理 (Spatial Reasoning), and 同义识别 (Synonym Recognition), in a fixed order. The left vertical axis represents the quantity, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1200, marked at intervals of 200. The right vertical axis represents the accuracy rate, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, marked at intervals of 0.1. Each category is represented by a pair of bars: a blue bar indicating the training set quantity and an orange bar indicating the verification set quantity, with values ranging from 5 to 1210 and 40 to 675, respectively. The blue bars have values of approximately 1102, 1095, 1077, 1210, and 5, while the orange bars have values of approximately 250, 190, 40, 675, and 55. A gray line graph overlays the bar chart, representing the accuracy rate, with values of approximately 0.7666, 0.8714, 0.692, 0.2852, and 0.3769. The categories are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
